gaps.lead: The exam regulations forbid the use of mobile phones.
She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action continuing from a past point to now: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: The staff wear a uniform at all times.
gaps.sentence: The staff ___ a uniform at all times.

gaps.lead: People believe she was the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event: is thought to have + participle.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: Simon really ought to make a decision about his future.
gaps.sentence: It's high time Simon ___ about his future.
gaps.hint: it's high time + past; make a decision = make up one's mind
gaps.explanation: 'It's high time' takes the past subjunctive: 'made up his mind'.
